concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-boleto-bancario-android-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured Android Drop-in Sessions/Advanced Boleto add-on covering required shopper fields, flow-specific due-date keys, voucher presentation, and test/live offer lifecycle; source distinguishes due date from later Offer cancelled status.
warnings: Sessions names the optional due-date field deliverAt; Advanced names it deliveryDate. Do not substitute them.
PresentToShopper/voucher issuance and test promotion are not proof of real paid status.
The approved Boleto overview says unpaid offers remain open for 15 days after the due date before Offer cancelled; this does not establish late-payment acceptance.
